headline: We could not find a Google Maps card for Go 2 Guy Concrete under the business name, the owner's name, or (760) 703-5724.
summary: Go 2 Guy Concrete is a small family owned concrete contractor out of Ramona doing patios, driveways, sidewalks, slabs, foundations, steps, and stamped and decorative work. On Nextdoor you were a Neighborhood Favorite in 2024, and a neighbor wrote that "he is a great guy" and "yes he is legit." The leftover is Google: we searched Maps for Go 2 Guy Concrete, the name with Ramona, Go2Guys Concrete, Jesus Tello concrete, and your phone number, and found no card for your business, so someone who searches Google for a concrete contractor near Ramona sees other companies instead.

signals.note: On Google Maps we searched Go 2 Guy Concrete, Go 2 Guy Concrete Ramona CA, Go 2 Guys Concrete Ramona, Go2Guys Concrete, Jesus Tello Concrete Ramona, (760) 703-5724, and concrete contractors around Ramona. None turned up a card for your business. The searches showed other companies, including a Go2Guys concrete company in Chino Hills.
signals.next: Set up a free Google Business Profile as a service-area business, so you can show the area you cover without listing a home address.

signals.note: Your Nextdoor page lists (760) 703-5724 and go2guysconcrete@gmail.com, and the neighbor who recommended you passed along the same number.
signals.next: Use the same phone and inbox on a Google card when you make one.

signals.note: Nextdoor lists Monday to Saturday 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Sunday closed. With no Google card, those hours do not show up in a Google search.
signals.next: Copy the same hours onto a Google card.

signals.note: Your Nextdoor page has a photo gallery of your work. Without a Google card, none of those photos show up in a Google search.
signals.next: Put a few of your best pours on a Google card once it is set up.

signals.note: We did not find a website for Go 2 Guy Concrete. Nextdoor is the main page, with your story, services, hours, and the Neighborhood Favorite award.
signals.next: A Google card can act as a simple home page for now.

signals.note: Nextdoor and your state contractor license both show Go 2 Guy Concrete in Ramona with (760) 703-5724. Your inbox spells it go2guys, with an s.
signals.next: Use Go 2 Guy Concrete as the name on a new Google card so it matches your license.
